description.narrative:
Insatsen är ett kärnstöd till Never Again Rwanda (NAR) mellan juli 2022 och december 2025. Stödet riktas till genomförandet av NAR's strategiska plan 2022-24 Insatsens mål är att (1) bidra till NAR's strategimål att engagera det rwandiska samhället att arbeta för en hållbar fred och social rättvisa, att (2) stödja NAR:s organisatoriska utveckling som en demokratisk förändringsaktör och utvecklingsaktör i sin egen rätt, samt (3) att bidra till Sidas och ambassadens lärande om direkt stöd och kärnstöd till lokala civilsamhällesorganisationer.
NAR:s strategiska mål är: - Att stärka medborgarna med icke-våldsamma metoder för att lösa konflikter, bygga upp förtroende och främja traumaläkning och förebyggande av folkmord - Att främja deltagande och inkluderande beslutsprocesser och främja rättighetsbaserade strategier - Att öka ungdomarnas kapacitet att bli fredsagenter, förbättra deras försörjning, förespråka deras och de utsatta befolkningarnas rättigheter - Att bygga strategiska partnerskap för politiskt engagemang och opinionsbildning – Att bli en etablerad tankesmedja genom kvalitetsforskning

The objective of the intervention is (1) to contribute to NAR's mission as per its Strategic Plan 2021-25 to engage society to embrace sustainable peace and social justice; (2) to support NAR's organisational development as a democratic change agent and development actor in its own right, and (3) contribute to the Embassy's and Sida's learning on direct and core support to civil society organisations.
NAR's strategic objectives are: - To empower citizens with non-violent means of resolving conflict, build trust and promote trauma healing and genocide prevention - To promote participatory and inclusive decision-making processes and advance rights-based approaches - To increase the capacity of the youth to become peace agents, improve their livelihoods, advocate for their rights and those of the vulnerable populations - To build strategic partnerships for policy engagement and advocacy - To become an established think tank through quality research

description.narrative:
During the contribution period and largely with the help of core funding, NAR has made the following key achievements.
Expansion of reach and impact through partnerships. Through strategic partnerships with community-based organizations (CBOs) NAR has increased its scope and effectiveness. Initiatives has benefited 18.000 directly and more than 1.500.000 indirectly, empowering them with the knowledge and skills necessary to promote peace, reconciliation and good governance. Also in the area of advocacy, NAR has increased its work with other CSOs throgh, for example, consortiums on different thematic advocacy.
Advancing advocacy efforts. NAR has strengthened its position and influence in promoting democratic values and civic space Rwanda. This is particularly the case in advocating for effective citizen participation in the governance sector, and most recently connected to the Sector Strategic Plan development in the framework of the upcoming new National Plan for Transformation II, where NAR has been instrumental in ensuring commitments to improve citizen participation mechanisms. In the past year, NAR has increasinly pushed some boundaries, for example by organising a two-day conference on democracy in Rwanda and by being in the forefront of the civil society advocacy to influence the new NGO law at the Parliament.
Building of institutional capacity. NAR has made investments in building the capacity of its organization, strengthening financial management and developing and applying tools for sub-granting, and not least by being able to recruit qualified personnel for key functions.
Detailed results and progress in the different programme pillars can be found in the Annual Report 2023.
